messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] gpu-pool eu-west-1-gpu-pool-42 queue growth detected after rollout of model v29. queue_size=1243, qps_in=2200, active_gpus=48/48, autoscaler_state=not_scaling. paging oncall.
samir (oncall-ml): on it — grabbing recent rollout logs. any customer-facing errors observed yet?
jess (oncall-sre): getting paged too. seeing a lot of 429s from front proxies, user-visible latency spikes.
eli (cs): multiple customer support tickets inbound mentioning slow responses and timeouts. flagged large enterprise client (acme-corp) affected.
marta (infra): checking autoscaler: max_nodes=48, current_nodes=48, scale_decision_errors show "quota_exceeded" and "insufficient_quota: GPU quota hard limit". looks like we hit reserved capacity cap.
alex (platform): model v29 introduced extended prefill and kv-cache prefetch on first token, per request memory ~2.8GB (was 1.1GB). rough math -> effective capacity halved.
samir (oncall-ml): that matches. v29 has wider context window default + aggressive kv prefetch. probably fanout/prefill amplification. we need short-term mitigation: reduce prefill or route traffic to v28/quantized variant.
jess (oncall-sre): agreed. will start throttling new model variant and enable fallback routing. executing emergency routing change now.
deploy-bot: Aborting canary: rollout v29 -> v28 rollback initiated by jess at 2026-03-15T22:45:30Z
jess (oncall-sre): executed routing patch: route /model/v29 -> fallback v28-quantized for 90% of traffic, 10% to v29 for diagnostics. patch:
```
POST /api/v1/routes/patch
{"route":"/model/generate","policy":{"preferred":["v28-q","v29"],"weights":[0.9,0.1]}}
```

marta (infra): manual scale-up to reserved pool requested; vendor quota says hard cap at 48 but we have spare burst pool in eu-west-1-burst. I'm initiating burst allocation.
infra-bot: burst allocation request sent to vendor: request_id=burst-20260315-889, expected provisioning ETA ~ 6m.
samir (oncall-ml): running quick mitigations: disable kv-prefetch for v29 (hotpatch) and reduce max_context default. applying config:
```
kubectl exec -it v29-hotpatch -- /bin/sh -c 'export REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0; export MAX_CONTEXT=4096; restart-service'
```

alex (platform): observability: queue dropped from 1243 -> 420 in ~4m after routing patch + burst alloc. token/sec cost still high but latency improving.
eli (cs): notifying acme-corp and other top 5 customers: sending templated note with ETA for full rollback + mitigation steps. will open dedicated bridge if they request.
samir (oncall-ml): handing to platform team for post-incident cleanup and postmortem. primary cause: v29 rollout introduced aggressive prefill/kv prefetching that multiplied GPU memory footprint, autoscaler hit hard max_nodes limit and vendor quota prevented automatic scale-out.
alex (platform): I will take ownership. next steps: (1) confirm rollout freeze for v29, (2) update model onboarding checklist to require perf/growth sim for prefill, (3) propose autoscaler soft-quotas + early throttles to avoid hitting hard vendor caps, (4) postmortem & customer impact summary.
jess (oncall-sre): final check: 429s trending down to baseline, handing back to platform. moving to incident resolved -> mitigated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=high, start_ts=1778004321, mitigated_ts=1778004372, next_action=create-postmortem (owner: alex).
